entities.name: Batista's Rise to Power
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Fulgencio Batista emerged from the 'Revolt of the Sergeants' in 1933 to become Cuba's dominant political figure. He ruled directly or through proxy presidents, oversaw a new constitution in 1940, served as elected president (1940–1944), then left office peacefully before staging a coup in 1952.
